definitions.gloss: fish dish; fish cuisine; seafood cooking
definitions.explanation: Any dish or course made primarily with fish. Encompasses a wide range of Japanese and international preparations, from raw sashimi to grilled, simmered, and fried fish dishes.

examples.japanese: {魚料理|さかなりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm good at making fish dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{魚料理|さかなりょうり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧だ。
examples.english: This restaurant has a reputation for delicious fish dishes.

notes:
Combines ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧ (fish) and ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (cooking, dish). A basic culinary term frequently used on menus, in cooking shows, and in everyday conversation about food. In Japanese restaurants, {魚料理|さかなりょうり} on a menu typically refers to the fish course or fish-based entrée.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魚料理|さかなりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a fish dish
- {魚料理|さかなりょうり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: a restaurant specializing in fish
- ⟦{旬|しゅん}→旬：12716_shun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{魚料理|さかなりょうり}: seasonal fish dish
- ⟦{和風|わふう}→和風：12034_wafuu⟧{魚料理|さかなりょうり}: Japanese-style fish dish

COMMON TYPES OF FISH DISHES:
- ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧: sashimi (raw fish slices)
- ⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧: grilled fish
- ⟦{煮魚|にざかな}→煮魚：16484_nizakana⟧: simmered fish
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧{魚|ざかな}: fried fish
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{南蛮漬|なんばんづ}け→南蛮漬け：27594_nanbanzuke⟧: fish in vinegar sauce with vegetables

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肉料理|にくりょうり}→肉料理：19402_nikuryouri⟧: meat dish — the counterpart for meat-based dishes
- {海鮮料理|かいせんりょうり}: seafood cuisine — broader term including shellfish, squid, and other sea creatures
